'''''Star Wars Jedi: Survivor''''' is a [[canon]] single-player [[Star Wars video games|video game]] in the ''[[Star Wars Jedi]]'' franchise. It was developed by [[Respawn Entertainment]] and released by [[Electronic Arts]] as a sequel to the [[2019]] game ''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]''. It was first announced on [[January 25]], [[2022]],<ref name="Reveal" /> but its title and early details about the game's setting were revealed in a CGI teaser trailer that premiered at [[Celebration Anaheim (2022)|Celebration Anaheim]] on [[May 27]], 2022.<ref name="SWCA">{{SW|url=news/swca-2022-star-wars-jedi-survivor-interview|text=SWCA 2022: Respawn's Stig Asmussen Talks ''Star Wars Jedi: Survivor'' and Reflects on Its Predecessor – Exclusive}}</ref> A gameplay trailer was later released during [[:wikipedia:The Game Awards 2022|The Game Awards 2022]] on [[December 8]], 2022.<ref name="TGA">{{Twitter|username=starwars|url=status/1599813247573655553|name=[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-12-05|quote=The journey continues… Experience the action-packed gameplay of Star Wars Jedi: Survivor during [https://twitter.com/thegameawards @thegameawards] – streaming live Dec. 8. [https://twitter.com/hashtag/StarWarsJediSurvivor #StarWarsJediSurvivor]}}</ref> Initially set to release on [[March 17]], [[2023]],<ref name="Teaser" /> ''Survivor'' was briefly delayed<ref name="New Release Date">{{Twitter|username=EAStarWars|url=status/1620527593580806145|name=EA [[Star Wars]]|date=2023-01-31|quote=Star Wars Jedi: Survivor Now Arrives April 28th}}</ref> to its official release of [[April 28]], 2023.<ref name="SurvivorRelease">{{Twitter|username=starwars|url=status/1651976713101004800|name=[[Star Wars]]|date=2023-04-28|quote=It's time to stand against the darkness. [https://twitter.com/hashtag/StarWarsJediSurvivor #StarWarsJediSurvivor] is AVAILABLE NOW!}}</ref>
